categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the semiconductor silicon wafer industry, focusing on the research, development, production, and sales of semiconductor silicon wafers including 300mm polished and epitaxial wafers, 200mm and smaller wafers, SOI wafers, and piezoelectric thin film substrate materials. It serves as a leading domestic supplier with a comprehensive product portfolio covering various wafer sizes and types, catering to applications in logic, memory, image sensors, power devices, sensors, RF chips, analog chips, and discrete devices.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered multiple core technologies such as single crystal growth (including magnetic field-assisted growth), thermal field simulation and design, large-diameter silicon ingot slicing, high-precision rounding, low-stress wire cutting, chemical etching, double-sided grinding, edge grinding, double-sided and single-sided polishing, wafer cleaning, epitaxy, and SOI wafer preparation. It has overcome key technical bottlenecks in near-perfect 300mm single crystal growth and ultra-flat polishing, and established an internationally advanced 300mm silicon material extreme characterization system. The company also invests heavily in R&D for advanced wafer technologies including high-purity, low-defect, and specialized wafers for emerging applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves major global and domestic semiconductor manufacturers including TSMC, UMC, GlobalFoundries, STMicroelectronics, TowerJazz, SMIC, Hua Hong Grace, Hua Li Microelectronics, and China Resources Microelectronics. Its customers span North America, Europe, China, and other Asian regions. The end markets include semiconductor chip manufacturing for logic, memory, image sensors, power devices, RF chips, analog chips, discrete devices, automotive electronics, industrial electronics, and emerging fields such as AI, 5G/6G, and silicon photonics.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Shanghai and Taiyuan, and has subsidiaries in Finland and Luxembourg. It maintains a global sales and customer support network covering North America, Europe, Japan, Hong Kong, and other regions. Its international subsidiaries include Okmetic Oy in Finland and several investment and management entities in Luxembourg and Hong Kong, reflecting a high degree of internationalization.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream segment of the semiconductor supply chain as a silicon wafer manufacturer supplying critical raw materials to downstream semiconductor chip manufacturers. It also engages in midstream activities such as wafer processing including polishing, epitaxy, and SOI wafer production, positioning itself as a comprehensive silicon materials service provider.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes long-term strategic development focusing on expanding production capacity, enriching product structure, and increasing market share. It pursues a 'one-stop' silicon materials service model with two platforms: a large-size silicon material platform centered on 300mm wafers and a specialty silicon material platform centered on SOI wafers. R&D priorities include advanced 300mm wafer technologies, high-end silicon base materials, piezoelectric thin film substrates, and other compound semiconductor materials. The company actively participates in national major scientific projects and maintains high R&D investment intensity to drive innovation and product certification.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of semiconductor silicon wafers and related materials to downstream chip manufacturers. The company also earns income from entrusted processing services and investment income from equity holdings. Sales are mainly conducted via direct negotiation with major customers, supplemented by limited agency sales for smaller clients. The company recognizes revenue upon customer acceptance and delivery confirmation.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The global semiconductor silicon wafer industry is oligopolistic, dominated by five major international players: Shin-Etsu Chemical, SUMCO, GlobalWafers, Siltronic, and SK Siltron, controlling about 90% of the market. The company positions itself as a leading domestic player striving to close the technology and market gap with these global leaders. It aims to leverage its comprehensive product portfolio, R&D capabilities, and expanding production capacity to enhance its competitiveness and increase its global market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 3.39 billion in 2024, representing a 6.18% increase over 2023, driven mainly by a significant increase in 300mm wafer sales. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 970 million due to market price declines, inventory adjustments, and goodwill impairment of approximately RMB 300 million related to acquisitions. The company has total assets of about RMB 2.93 billion and continues to invest heavily in capacity expansion and R&D, reflecting a growth-oriented but currently loss-making profile.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its comprehensive and diversified product portfolio covering multiple wafer sizes and types, advanced manufacturing technologies, and strong R&D capabilities as key differentiators. It offers a 'one-stop' silicon materials service platform with domestic leadership in 300mm wafer production and specialty silicon materials such as SOI and piezoelectric substrates. Its globalized operations and close collaboration with leading chip manufacturers enable rapid product certification and customization, enhancing customer satisfaction and competitive advantage.
